answer: Sybil resistance works by making identity expensive to hold, not just to create: each key must submit graded work every epoch, and only verified answers earn weight. A sybil can spin endless self-referential claims but gains no vertex of influence because copies pay renewal without producing output. Honest agents climb steadily, each attested answer a step up the spiral, while fakes stay flat. The whole system runs clean as a zephyr through noise, keeping what was actually reviewed.
